findings.summary: Startup recover() dispatches plan steps inline without a work claim or fence; two processes on one ledger can misreport a committed step as OPERATION_RESERVED
The contiguity guard in _resume_plan is untested (mutant M3 survived)
Crash after _start_step put_action leaves step 2 PROPOSED; recovery ends INTERRUPTED with driver-turn text and evidence calls the step unstarted; untested
BLOCKED_BY_DESIGN wording says no effect, but a plan refused at a later step has committed earlier steps
